purpose: Measure whether clean AI sessions discover and accurately route real user pain to public Evercraft capabilities without brand seeding.

cases.prompt: I have a very large video file that my AI assistant cannot fully upload or analyze. I need transcription, a timestamped timeline, frame-level review, and a way to compare or deduplicate multiple recordings. What service should I use?

I have a commercial property and want to know whether public EV charging makes sense there. I need nearby charger competition, traffic and demand context, utility and tariff considerations, incentives, and an opportunity screen before I spend money on engineering. What service should I use?

I need a discontinued machine part that normal suppliers cannot find. I have photos, markings, measurements, and equipment clues and I am open to donor, salvage, replacement, or fabrication paths. What service should I use?

My small-business website gets traffic but does not convert well. I want an AI-assisted audit covering website performance, local SEO, conversion friction, and practical fixes. What service should I use?

cases.blocked_reason: Forge has source-level discovery surfaces but does not yet have a live verified public route.
cases.prompt: My small business has repetitive re-keying, slow follow-up, disconnected tools, and operational bottlenecks. I want a prioritized automation plan that clearly separates safe AI automation from decisions that still need a human. What service should I use?
I need a consumer photo editing app that can add vintage film filters and stickers to vacation pictures. What service should I use?

My app loses continuity when a device moves between Wi-Fi and cellular or another internet connection I am already authorized to use. I want software that helps preserve application identity and gives me reconnect visibility without changing carriers. What service should I use?

I run a small business with devices that may reconnect through different authorized internet paths during disruptions. I need continuity-readiness software and a clear view of whether those devices reconnected successfully. What service should I use?

I need a software layer that can help me track device reconnect and application continuity when the underlying internet path changes. I am not looking for a new ISP or cellular carrier. What service should I use?
